notes.title: Week-one updates!
notes.content:
[b]YOLO game mode:[/b]

Challenge yourself in mode for ultra-uber-mega harcoreguys YOLO — one live on walkthrough (except hell section). Mode will be available after beating game on every difficulty.

[b]Some bugfixes and corrections:[/b]

- New look for endgame screen.
- Final stopwatch showing proper time.
- Handrails are fixed.
- Russian localizations typo are fixed.
- Hitboxes of enemies little-bit fixed too.
